name: Klipy GIF search
description: Powered by KLIPY. Finds animated GIFs for Variable Images in generated promos and overlays. Uses sticker search when transparent backgrounds are requested. Needs a Klipy API key; pictures are kept and reused with their animation intact.
author: SchedularrTV

settings.label: API key
settings.description: Stored in plain text in the settings file, readable by anyone who can open your data folder. KLIPY_API_KEY in the environment is used when this is empty.

settings.label: Safe search
settings.description: Uses Klipy's high content filter to leave explicit results out. Recommended for anything that airs.

settings.label: Country
settings.description: Optional two-letter country code for localized search results.
